thread:
cory_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the catalog lifecycle playbook for the next roadmap sprint. Primary concerns: onboarding criteria, pinning policy, deprecation notice windows, and migration tooling. Who's got objections to current draft?
emma_product: I think we need clear launch criteria first. Proposal: (1) automated benchmark pass for latency + quality, (2) perf regressions <= 2% vs baseline, (3) docs + eval deck uploaded, (4) migration runbook exists.
rafael_eng: Agree on launch criteria. Two engineering asks: allow enterprise-exempt pin overrides and provide a safe canary CLI for migrations. How long should pin overrides be allowed?
lina_research: For benchmarks, we should require: eval harness with at least 3 representative datasets, quantized and full-precision profile, and target median-latency for 2k tokens under X ms (we discussed X in doc). Quality metric is a pass/fail with fuzzy-match threshold per dataset.
ajay_sre: On deprecation windows: standard is 90 days notice plus automated bump for pinned customers only after 180 days and explicit opt-in to auto-migrate. We also need a rollback SLA: canary rollback within 30 minutes automated if error_rate > 1% or latency 2x baseline.
emma_product: Scope negotiation: MVP should include onboarding checklist, auto-benchmark runner, pin toggle in console, deprecation notifications, and a minimal migration CLI. Defer fancy scheduling/auto-scheduling, cost-optimizer and UI for complex rollouts to v2.
rafael_eng: Sample CLI for canary I drafted: ```rwd migrate --from v1 --to v2 --canary 5% --monitor error_rate,latency --rollback-threshold error_rate>1%``` We can wire this to existing rollout engine.
cory_pm: Nice. For pinning policy: default behavior = auto-unpin after 90 days of inactivity unless customer explicitly pins (enterprise plan). Exceptions logged and surfaced to account team. Question: does that meet legal/compliance needs?
ajay_sre: Compliance needs explicit audit logs + KMS record; add that to launch checklist. Also add notification cadence: 30d, 14d, 7d, 1d before deprecation.
lina_research: Onbench parity: require both quality and generation distribution checks (token length, stop tokens) — prevents silent behavioral shifts. If any distribution shift > 5% we fail.
emma_product: Customer-driven asks: Several large customers asked for 6-month deprecation windows and guaranteed migration help. Propose offering extended-deprecation as a paid concierge add-on.
cory_pm: Action items: emma -- update launch checklist with notifications + concierge option. rafael -- prototype migration CLI and canary wiring (due EOW). lina -- finalize eval pass/fail thresholds and add sample datasets. ajay -- add audit log requirements + rollback automation. I'll consolidate into a single playbook doc and ping legal.
reminders-bot: Reminder set: Consolidate playbook doc (https://go/rdw/catalog-playbook) in 3 days.
emma_product: quick note: add a small customer-facing FAQ about pin behavior and what auto-migrate means.
cory_pm: OK closing — we'll review the consolidated playbook in next roadmap review. :thumbsup:
